title: Prime Minister shares an article on lesson for governance for Viksit Bharat 2047
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi,  today, shared an article written by Delhi Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta. The article underlines that Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s 25 years in public life reflect a commitment to Seva to address present needs and Sankalp to realise the aspirations of the future.
Highlighting key lessons for governance in Delhi, she emphasises the vision is to build a developed Delhi that meets the aspirations of its people and contributes to the national goal of Viksit Bharat 2047.
Shri Modi posted on X;
PM @narendramodi's 25 years in public life bring together Seva for today's needs and Sankalp for tomorrow's aspirations, writes Delhi CM Smt. @gupta_rekha.
She draws lessons for Delhi's governance, from reaching the last mile with welfare schemes to improving education, healthcare and skills. The goal is to build Viksit Delhi as a key part of Viksit Bharat 2047.
